# TrackerDisclosure

<!-- description:start -->
A collapsible section component with Tracker-specific styling. Extends Gravity UI [`Disclosure`](https://gravity-ui.com/components/disclosure) with a configurable chevron arrow (position and size), an optional toolbar slot rendered alongside the summary, and BEM class name hooks for fine-grained styling.
<!-- description:end -->

## Usage

```tsx
import {TrackerDisclosure} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<TrackerDisclosure summary="Section title" defaultExpanded>
    Content goes here
</TrackerDisclosure>
```

## Component props

<!-- props:start -->
```ts
{
    /**
     * Content shown in the clickable summary / header row.
     * Accepts a string or any ReactNode.
     */
    summary?: ReactNode;

    /**
     * Content rendered inside the collapsible body.
     */
    children?: ReactNode;

    /**
     * Whether the section is expanded on first render (uncontrolled).
     * @default false
     */
    defaultExpanded?: boolean;

    /**
     * Controlled expanded state. When provided, you must also handle onUpdate.
     */
    expanded?: boolean;

    /**
     * Callback fired when the expanded state changes.
     */
    onUpdate?: (expanded: boolean) => void;

    /**
     * Whether the disclosure is disabled (non-interactive).
     * @default false
     */
    disabled?: boolean;

    /**
     * Position of the chevron arrow relative to the summary text.
     * @default 'end'
     */
    arrowPosition?: 'start' | 'end';

    /**
     * Size of the chevron arrow icon in pixels.
     * @default 20
     */
    arrowSize?: number;

    /**
     * Optional ReactNode rendered to the right of the toggle button inside the
     * summary row. Useful for action buttons (edit, delete, add, …).
     */
    toolbar?: ReactNode;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the root element.
     */
    className?: string;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the summary row wrapper.
     */
    summaryClassName?: string;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the toggle `<button>` element.
     */
    toggleClassName?: string;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the chevron arrow icon.
     */
    arrowClassName?: string;
}
```
<!-- props:end -->

> **Note:** `TrackerDisclosure` accepts all props from Gravity UI [`DisclosureProps`](https://gravity-ui.com/components/disclosure) in addition to the Tracker-specific ones listed above.

---

## Examples

### Basic (uncontrolled)

```tsx
import {TrackerDisclosure} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<TrackerDisclosure summary="Sprint details" defaultExpanded>
    <p>Sprint 42 — 14 issues, 3 in progress.</p>
</TrackerDisclosure>
```

---

### Controlled

```tsx
import React, {useState} from 'react';
import {TrackerDisclosure} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

export const ControlledExample = () => {
    const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

    return (
        <TrackerDisclosure
            summary="Filters"
            expanded={expanded}
            onUpdate={setExpanded}
        >
            <p>Filter content here.</p>
        </TrackerDisclosure>
    );
};
```

---

### Arrow at start

```tsx
<TrackerDisclosure summary="Description" arrowPosition="start">
    <p>Content with the chevron on the left.</p>
</TrackerDisclosure>
```

---

### With toolbar

The `toolbar` prop renders additional content (e.g. action buttons) to the right of the toggle button, inside the summary row but outside the toggle click area.

```tsx
import {Button} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';
import {TrackerDisclosure} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<TrackerDisclosure
    summary="Attachments"
    toolbar={
        <Button size="s" view="flat" onClick={() => openUploadDialog()}>
            Add file
        </Button>
    }
>
    <AttachmentList />
</TrackerDisclosure>
```

---

### Disabled

```tsx
<TrackerDisclosure summary="Locked section" disabled defaultExpanded>
    <p>This section cannot be collapsed by the user.</p>
</TrackerDisclosure>
```

---

### Multiple sections (accordion-like)

```tsx
import React, {useState} from 'react';
import {TrackerDisclosure} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

const SECTIONS = ['Details', 'Attachments', 'Comments'];

export const AccordionExample = () => {
    const [openIndex, setOpenIndex] = useState<number | null>(0);

    return (
        <>
            {SECTIONS.map((title, i) => (
                <TrackerDisclosure
                    key={title}
                    summary={title}
                    expanded={openIndex === i}
                    onUpdate={(open) => setOpenIndex(open ? i : null)}
                >
                    <p>Content for {title}</p>
                </TrackerDisclosure>
            ))}
        </>
    );
};
```
